item.text:
No additional defect was confirmed in this pass. The audit has reached practical saturation across the authorized source, public APIs, feature combinations, storage fault paths, and randomized crash/recovery scenarios.

The report remains at 27 confirmed findings. The most significant are:

- LFU cache resynchronization producing different replica values at the same decided index,
- delta-snapshot synchronization corrupting decided state,
- `AcceptSync` regressing a decided index,
- persistent failed-write leakage and destructive partial replacement,
- timeout retry duplication,
- LRU bincode deserialization failure.

All reproduction sources, commands, and retained logs are indexed in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
